title: CVE Records Solana Vulnerabilities
text:
CVE Records for Solana

CVE-2022-21449: Solana validator memory corruption
CVE-2022-31016: Solana Labs validator RPC DoS vulnerability
CVE-2023-36829: solana-web3.js prototype pollution
CVE-2024-54134: solana-web3.js supply chain attack (npm package compromise)
  - Malicious versions 1.95.7 and 1.95.8 published
  - Private key exfiltration from browser wallets
  - $160,000 in losses

Solana Program Vulnerabilities (non-CVE):
- Wormhole bridge: missing guardian verification (Feb 2022, $320M)
- Cashio: infinite mint via fake collateral accounts (Mar 2022, $48M)
- Mango Markets: oracle price manipulation (Oct 2022, $114M)
- Crema Finance: flash loan tick account manipulation (Jul 2022, $9M)
- Nirvana Finance: flash loan AMM manipulation (Jul 2022, $3.5M)

Common vulnerability classes in CVEs:
- Memory safety issues in validator code (C/Rust unsafe)
- Integer overflow in financial calculations
- Missing authentication on privileged operations
- Supply chain attacks on JavaScript SDKs
- Oracle manipulation in DeFi protocols
Source: cve.org, NVD
